Requires Permissions.Customers.Create. fullNameAr is required; fullNameEn is optional. documents is optional: array of { documentType (1=IdentityDocument, 2=DrivingLicense, 3=Passport, 4=Other), fileId (from POST /api/attachments/upload), sortOrder }. identityType: 1=National, 2=Residence, 3=Visitor, 4=Gulf. Send the nested object matching identityType: national/residence = { beneficiaryIdNumber, hijriBirthDate?, birthDate?, isHijriBirthDate, email? } (isHijriBirthDate defaults true for National, false for Residence; when true send hijriBirthDate as an Umm al-Qura yyyymmdd integer, when false send Gregorian birthDate); visitor = { email, birthDate, borderNumber, passportNumber, licenseNumber, licenseExpiryDate, licenseIssuePlace, countryId, identityCopyNumber, identityExpiryDate }; gulf = same as visitor but with beneficiaryIdNumber instead of border/passport. birthDate is Gregorian and required for visitor/gulf (Tajeer requirement). After identity map, create calls POST /api/blacklist/check (best-effort). A verified network hit (2+ offices) auto-sets local IsBlacklisted with reason Blacklist.NetworkMatchReason; awaiting (1 office) does not. Response stays { id } — check GET customer for the flag.

Requires Permissions.Customers.Create. Visitor requires border/passport/license/country/identity-copy fields, Gregorian birthDate, and email. Same best-effort network blacklist check as National create (auto-flag only when verified).
Requires Permissions.Customers.View

request.description: Records vehicle return. checklist (معاينة الإرجاع) is required and all 5 items must be true. Send typed JSON (not stringified): sketchInfoAtReturn [{ type, x, y }], condition { isOk, note?, attachmentId? }. Transitions to Completed and releases the vehicle. Requires Permissions.Contracts.Return.
Returns the return snapshot (charges + condition) or null if not yet returned. Requires Permissions.Contracts.View.

Marks a contract as disputed. Allowed while Overdue and not yet returned, or after return while still inside the snapshotted dispute window (DisputeWindowHours after ReturnedAt). Does not change contract status. Suggested late fee is paused while disputed. Requires Permissions.Contracts.Return.
Returns 4 KPI cards: overdueCount, averageLatenessMinutes, penaltiesThisMonth, disputesOpen. Requires Permissions.LateReturns.View. Branch-scoped.
Paged table of overdue and resolved-with-late-fee contracts. displayStatus: "active" | "disputed" | "resolved" (null = all). Requires Permissions.LateReturns.View.
Tenant-wide late-return rules (graceHours, perHourDivisor, fullDayThresholdHours). Creates defaults 1 / 8 / 4 on first GET. Snapshotted onto new/updated drafts. Requires Permissions.Settings.View.
Updates tenant-wide late-return rules used as defaults for new drafts. Existing issued contracts keep their snapshot. Requires Permissions.Settings.Edit.
Tenant-wide dispute window (hours after return) and terms. Creates defaults (72h + two seed terms) on first GET. Snapshotted onto new/updated drafts. Requires Permissions.Settings.View.
Updates the dispute window and terms. Window is measured after return, not from contract EndAt. Requires Permissions.Settings.Edit.
